# Knowledge base

| feature | summary | spec | contract |

| rail | Rail cards, attention versus manual order, pin, drag reorder, session count. | `docs/features/rail/spec.md` | `docs/features/rail/contract.md` |

| rename | Muster-owned session title override, inline rename in the mainhead and tiles. | `docs/features/rename/spec.md` | `docs/features/rename/contract.md` |
| settings | Settings dialog and the prefs it edits. | `docs/features/settings/spec.md` | `docs/features/settings/contract.md` |
| shortcuts | Keyboard chords routed to views, focus and tiles. | `docs/features/shortcuts/spec.md` | `docs/features/shortcuts/contract.md` |
| surfaces | PTY bridge, xterm pane, the ephemeral shell surface, sizing, one live client per target. | `docs/features/surfaces/spec.md` | `docs/features/surfaces/contract.md` |
| theme | Muster theme preference and the Claude theme family poll. | `docs/features/theme/spec.md` | `docs/features/theme/contract.md` |

| triage | GitHub issues into TODO.md through a program, and the pre-commit link guard. | `docs/features/triage/spec.md` | `docs/features/triage/contract.md` |

| usage | Masthead usage bars, per-model weekly bar, per-session context gauge, usage poll and Keychain read. | `docs/features/usage/spec.md` | `docs/features/usage/contract.md` |
| views | Focus and Tiles switch, density preference, view containers. | `docs/features/views/spec.md` | `docs/features/views/contract.md` |

## Facts

- `kb:fact/background-completion-new-prompt-id` — A finished background task re-invokes the main agent as a UserPromptSubmit with a new prompt_id whose prompt begins <task-notification>. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-completion-new-prompt-id.md`
- `kb:fact/background-tasks-field` — Stop.background_tasks lists running subagents and backgrounded shells with status "running", [] when nothing is outstanding. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-tasks-field.md`
- `kb:fact/clear-mints-new-session-id` — /clear emits SessionEnd{reason:"clear"} for the old session_id, then SessionStart{source:"clear"} with a new id in the same pane. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/clear-mints-new-session-id.md`
- `kb:fact/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env` — Command hooks and the status-line script inherit the pane environment on every event, ~50 ms per event; an unmanaged session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env.md`
- `kb:fact/config-dir-breaks-oauth` — CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolates settings, hooks and transcripts but breaks subscription OAuth ("Not logged in · Please run /login"). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, launch) → `docs/facts/config-dir-breaks-oauth.md`
- `kb:fact/context-window-shape` — context_window carries context_window_size, used/remaining_percentage on a 0-100 scale, token totals and a current_usage object. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/context-window-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/fable-model-alias` — fable is a valid --model alias: the bundle's alias switch has case"fable":case"mythos" beside haiku/sonnet/opus. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/fable-model-alias.md`
- `kb:fact/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence` — Headless claude -p fires the full hook sequence, including the command-wrapped SessionStart, so hook probes need no tmux. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/facts/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-commands-are-shell-lines` — Command-hook command and statusLine.command are /bin/sh -c command lines, not argv paths; an unquoted space-bearing path breaks both. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.245..2.1.267; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/facts/hook-commands-are-shell-lines.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-delivery-best-effort` — Hooks are at-most-once with no timestamps or sequence numbers; kill -9 emits nothing and a SIGTERM emits SessionEnd but no Stop-family event. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-delivery-best-effort.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-payload-fields` — Per-event hook field inventory: the common set on every hook, prompt_id on all but SessionStart, and each event's own fields. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/hook-payload-fields.md`
- `kb:fact/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit` — On the authentication-failure exit Claude Code does not wait for hook children: StopFailure is at risk and SessionEnd is usually lost. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.246..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, canary) → `docs/facts/hooks-not-awaited-on-failure-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/local-settings-honoured` — Project-scoped .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json alone each honour hooks, statusLine and allowedHttpHookUrls. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/facts/local-settings-honoured.md`
- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/notification-types-observed` — Notification.notification_type: idle_prompt ~60 s after Stop, and permission_prompt sharing PermissionRequest's prompt_id. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/notification-types-observed.md`
- `kb:fact/oauth-token-in-keychain` — The subscription OAuth token lives in the macOS Keychain item "Claude Code-credentials" as claudeAiOauth.accessToken. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/oauth-token-in-keychain.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-auto-model-gated` — --permission-mode auto is model-gated: on haiku the TUI prints "auto mode unavailable for this model" and every hook reports default. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-auto-model-gated.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-flag-on-wire` — --permission-mode is reflected verbatim on UserPromptSubmit.permission_mode; the CLI's manual choice is spelled default on the wire. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-flag-on-wire.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-mode-presence-split` — permission_mode is not universal: six hook events always carry it, five never do; values seen are default, plan, acceptEdits, auto. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/permission-mode-presence-split.md`
- `kb:fact/permission-suggestions-optional` — PermissionRequest.permission_suggestions is optional: present on a Write request in default mode, absent on ExitPlanMode in plan mode. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/permission-suggestions-optional.md`
- `kb:fact/plan-mode-hook-sequence` — Leaving plan mode fires PreToolUse{ExitPlanMode, plan}, then PermissionRequest{ExitPlanMode}, then PostToolUse{ExitPlanMode, acceptEdits}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/plan-mode-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/rate-limits-wire-shape` — rate_limits has five_hour and seven_day buckets (not weekly), each {used_percentage: float, resets_at: Unix epoch integer}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/rate-limits-wire-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/refresh-interval-seconds` — statusLine.refreshInterval is in seconds, not milliseconds, and ticks while idle; without it an idle session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/refresh-interval-seconds.md`
- `kb:fact/resume-keeps-session-identity` — claude --resume <id> emits SessionStart{source:"resume"} with the original session_id and transcript_path. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/facts/resume-keeps-session-identity.md`
- `kb:fact/scroll-speed-env-present` — CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED is present in the installed bundle; the static canary tier asserts every LaunchEnv key by byte string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, surfaces) → `docs/facts/scroll-speed-env-present.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionend-reason-ambiguous` — SessionEnd.reason is "other" for both a killed pane and a normal exit; only "clear" is distinguishable, and kill -9 emits nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionend-reason-ambiguous.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-model-optional-string` — SessionStart.model, when present, is a plain model-ID string, never an object; it is absent on headless startups and on /clear. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-model-optional-string.md`
- `kb:fact/sessionstart-not-over-http` — SessionStart is silently never delivered over a type:"http" hook; the other nine events are. A type:"command" hook delivers it. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/sessionstart-not-over-http.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-has-no-model-bucket` — The status line carries only five_hour and seven_day (plus spend_limit on gateway accounts); the per-model weekly window is never copied in. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-has-no-model-bucket.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-keys` — Status-line top-level keys; permission_mode is never among them. Newer versions add scratchpad_dir and prompt_cache (superset). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/status-line-keys.md`
- `kb:fact/status-model-is-object` — The status line's model is an {id, display_name} object; only SessionStart.model is a bare string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/status-model-is-object.md`
- `kb:fact/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs` — Status-line posts are event-driven, ~50 ms after tool activity, and arrive in close pairs a median 435 ms apart. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`
- `kb:fact/status-version-matches-installed` — The status-line version field equals the installed claude --version. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: canary, connection) → `docs/facts/status-version-matches-installed.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-error-taxonomy` — StopFailure.error observed: authentication_failed, server_error, unknown; ten values exist in the binary, and the mapping is not pass-through. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-error-taxonomy.md`
- `kb:fact/stopfailure-replaces-stop` — A failed turn emits StopFailure instead of Stop, never both; a successful turn emits Stop only. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/stopfailure-replaces-stop.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id` — Tool hooks fired by a subagent carry the parent prompt_id plus agent_id and agent_type, and arrive after the parent's Stop when backgrounded. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/subagent-hooks-carry-agent-id.md`
- `kb:fact/subagent-permission-request-marked` — A subagent's PermissionRequest carries agent_id and agent_type; the permission_prompt Notification that follows carries no agent marker. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/subagent-permission-request-marked.md`
- `kb:fact/theme-config-key-and-enum` — Claude Code's theme is the global-config key theme with a six-value enum; family is startsWith("light"); default dark. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.258..2.1.267; features: theme) → `docs/facts/theme-config-key-and-enum.md`
- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-exit` — The workspace-trust prompt preselects "No, exit" (2.1.259+): a bare Enter exits the session; the harness moves the marker first. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-exit.md`
- `kb:fact/unknown-before-first-response` — Before a session's first API response rate_limits is absent and the context percentages are null: unknown, not 0%. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/unknown-before-first-response.md`
- `kb:fact/usage-api-oauth-shape` — GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the OAuth bearer and anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 returns five_hour, seven_day and limits[]. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/usage-api-oauth-shape.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:fact/trust-prompt-preselects-yes` — Retired: through 2.1.246 the workspace-trust prompt preselected "Yes", so a bare Enter accepted it. (retired, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.246; features: launch, canary) → `docs/facts/trust-prompt-preselects-yes.md`
